name: Hyperlink
description: Represents a hyperlink associated with a non-placeholder shape or text.
remarks: Use a hyperlink to jump to an Internet or intranet site, to another file, or to a slide within the active presentation. The Hyperlink object is a member of the Hyperlinks collection. The Hyperlinks collection contains all the hyperlinks on a slide or a master.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of hyperlink. Read-only.

properties.name: Address
properties.description: Returns or sets the Internet address (URL) to the target document. Read/write.

properties.name: SubAddress
properties.description: Returns or sets the location within a document - such as a bookmark in a word document, a range in a Microsoft Office Excel worksheet, or a slide in a Microsoft PowerPoint presentation - associated with the specified hyperlink. Read/write.

properties.name: EmailSubject
properties.description: Returns or sets the text string of the hyperlink subject line. The subject line is appended to the Internet address (URL) of the hyperlink. Read/write.

properties.name: ScreenTip
properties.description: Returns or sets the ScreenTip text of a hyperlink. Read/write.

properties.name: TextToDisplay
properties.description: Returns or sets the display text for a hyperlink not associated with a graphic. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowAndReturn
properties.description: Determines if and under what circumstances Microsoft PowerPoint returns to the initiating slide show. Read/write.

methods.name: AddToFavorites
methods.description: Adds a shortcut that represents the specified hyperlink's target document to the Favorites folder in the Windows folder.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Displays the HTML document associated with the specified hyperlink in a new web browser window.

methods.name: CreateNewDocument
methods.signature: CreateNewDocument(FileName As String, EditNow As MsoTriState, Overwrite As MsoTriState)
methods.description: Creates a new Web presentation associated with the specified hyperlink.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The path and file name of the document.

parameters.name: EditNow
parameters.description: Determines whether the document is opened immediately in its associated editor.

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: Determines whether any existing file of the same name in the same folder is overwritten.
